```{r pivot}
# ── Pivot ──
pivot_table_df <- stack_tables |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = `preType`,
    names_from = `postType`,
    values_from = `weight`,
    values_fn = sum,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# The matrix half of the same pivot: row labels moved into rownames.
pivot_matrix_df <- as.matrix(pivot_table_df[, -1])
rownames(pivot_matrix_df) <- pivot_table_df[[1]]
```

```{r muted-step}
# ── Muted step ──
# This node is muted on the canvas, so it produced nothing and nothing
# downstream of it ran. It is kept here so a muted node is not mistaken for
# one missing from the document.
```

```{r normalize}
# ── Normalize ──
totals_ <- rowSums(pivot_matrix_df)
empty_ <- rowSums(pivot_matrix_df != 0, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
normalize <- pivot_matrix_df / ifelse(totals_ > 0, totals_, NA_real_)
normalize[empty_, ] <- 0
```

```{r heatmap-2}
# ── Heatmap ──
heatmap_2_out <- as.matrix(pivot_matrix_df)
# NOTE: The clustering follows seaborn's clustermap: each row is a vector
# across the columns. As in Coda, an empty cell counts as 0 and a constant
# vector is put at distance 1 from everything, so `cor`'s NA does not stop
# `hclust`.
x_ <- heatmap_2_out
x_[!is.finite(x_)] <- 0
d_ <- 1 - cor(t(x_))
d_[!is.finite(d_)] <- 1
diag(d_) <- 0
rows_ <- hclust(as.dist(d_), method = "average")$order
cols_ <- coda_follow_order(rownames(heatmap_2_out)[rows_], colnames(heatmap_2_out))
heatmap_2_out <- heatmap_2_out[rows_, cols_, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_2_rows <- coda_matrix_selection(rownames(heatmap_2_out), integer(0))
heatmap_2_columns <- coda_matrix_selection(colnames(heatmap_2_out), integer(0))

heatmap_2_out |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row") |>
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    row = factor(row, levels = rev(rownames(heatmap_2_out))),
    column = factor(column, levels = colnames(heatmap_2_out))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(column, row, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r heatmap-3}
# ── Heatmap ──
heatmap_3_out <- as.matrix(pivot_matrix_df)
if ("LC4" %in% rownames(heatmap_3_out)) {
  key_ <- which(rownames(heatmap_3_out) == "LC4")[1]
  cols_ <- rev(order(heatmap_3_out[key_, ], decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE, method = "radix"))
  rows_ <- coda_follow_order(colnames(heatmap_3_out)[cols_], rownames(heatmap_3_out))
} else {
  message("No row is called \"LC4\", so the columns keep their original order.")
  cols_ <- seq_len(ncol(heatmap_3_out))
  rows_ <- seq_len(nrow(heatmap_3_out))
}
heatmap_3_out <- heatmap_3_out[rows_, cols_, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_3_rows <- coda_matrix_selection(rownames(heatmap_3_out), integer(0))
heatmap_3_columns <- coda_matrix_selection(colnames(heatmap_3_out), integer(0))
hi_ <- max(abs(heatmap_3_out), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(hi_) || hi_ == 0) hi_ <- 1
lo_ <- -hi_

heatmap_3_out |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row") |>
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    row = factor(row, levels = rev(rownames(heatmap_3_out))),
    column = factor(column, levels = colnames(heatmap_3_out)),
    fill_ = pmin(pmax(value, lo_), hi_)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(column, row, fill = fill_)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = 1, limits = c(lo_, hi_)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = signif(value, 3)), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r heatmap-5}
# ── Heatmap ──
heatmap_5_out <- as.matrix(pivot_matrix_df)
keepRows_ <- grepl("^LC[0-9]+$", rownames(heatmap_5_out), ignore.case = TRUE)
keepCols_ <- !grepl("dn", tolower(colnames(heatmap_5_out)), fixed = TRUE)
heatmap_5_out <- heatmap_5_out[keepRows_, keepCols_, drop = FALSE]
rows_ <- order(rowSums(heatmap_5_out, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE, method = "radix")
cols_ <- coda_follow_order(rownames(heatmap_5_out)[rows_], colnames(heatmap_5_out))
heatmap_5_out <- heatmap_5_out[rows_, cols_, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_5_rows <- coda_matrix_selection(rownames(heatmap_5_out), integer(0))
heatmap_5_columns <- coda_matrix_selection(colnames(heatmap_5_out), integer(0))
# NOTE: Coda draws this in its own blue ramp, which has no name here; Blues
# is the nearest published one.
# NOTE: The card draws circles sized by value. This draws tiles instead; the
# numbers are the same either way.

heatmap_5_out |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row") |>
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    row = factor(row, levels = rev(rownames(heatmap_5_out))),
    column = factor(column, levels = colnames(heatmap_5_out))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(column, row, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r heatmap-6}
# ── Heatmap ──
heatmap_6_out <- as.matrix(pivot_matrix_df)

heatmap_6_rows <- coda_matrix_selection(rownames(heatmap_6_out), integer(0))
heatmap_6_columns <- coda_matrix_selection(colnames(heatmap_6_out), integer(0))
# NOTE: Coda draws this in its own blue ramp, which has no name here; Blues
# is the nearest published one.
hi_ <- 50
lo_ <- 0
# NOTE: Only the colour uses a log scale: the fill is log10(1 + value - low)
# and the label is the raw value. Cells past either end are clipped, as in
# Coda, and the legend is in transformed units.

heatmap_6_out |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row") |>
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    row = factor(row, levels = rev(rownames(heatmap_6_out))),
    column = factor(column, levels = colnames(heatmap_6_out)),
    fill_ = pmin(pmax(value, lo_), hi_),
    fill_ = log10(1 + fill_ - lo_)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(column, row, fill = fill_)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, limits = c(0, log10(1 + hi_ - lo_))) +
  geom_text(aes(label = signif(value, 3)), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
